The Mission We are looking for a builder-type Commercial Director who can take ownership of designing, building and scaling NEXON’s sales organization. This is not a role for someone who only wants to manage an existing sales team. You will be expected to understand the business, challenge our current approach and build the commercial system required for the next stage of growth. Your responsibility goes from: Commercial Strategy → Sales Architecture → CRM & Pipelines → Team → Execution → Forecasting → Revenue You will receive business objectives, resources and budget. You will own the commercial solution and its execution. What You Will Build You will design and implement a complete sales operating system, including: customer and market segmentation; separate sales motions for inbound, outbound, existing customers, high-intent leads and B2B/distributor opportunities; lead qualification and routing; CRM architecture and business requirements; opportunity types and multiple sales pipelines where required; clear sales stages, ownership rules and follow-up logic; sales territories and account ownership; pipeline management; 30/60/90-day revenue forecasting; sales KPIs and management dashboards; conversion and pipeline velocity measurement; sales capacity planning; sales playbooks and operating procedures; weekly and monthly sales management cadence; performance and accountability systems. Build the Team The system must not only exist on paper. You will determine what commercial capabilities and roles are required, define their responsibilities and participate directly in building the team. Depending on the resulting architecture, this may include Account Executives, Inside Sales, BDR/SDR, Account Managers, Key Account Managers and Sales Operations/RevOps capabilities. You will work together with HR on recruitment, but you will own the professional standard of the sales organization. You will establish onboarding, targets, coaching, performance management and the operating rhythm required to turn the team into a scalable sales engine. Own Business Results Success in this role is not measured by whether a CRM has been implemented or a new organizational chart has been created. It is measured by business outcomes. You will be expected to take ownership of: Revenue growth · Gross margin · Pipeline generation · Forecast accuracy · Conversion rates · Sales productivity · New customer acquisition · Existing customer development You should be able to explain not only what happened , but why it happened, what will happen next and what actions are required to close the gap.
